reach.en: Ask at your faculty's student office in the first two weeks.
reach.zu: Buza ehhovisi labafundi lefakhalthi yakho emasontweni amabili okuqala.

reach.en: Sign up during O-Week or through Student Affairs.
reach.zu: Bhalisa nge-O-Week noma ngoMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi.

reach.en: Ask Student Affairs or the SRC. Go early: you don't need to wait until you have nothing left.
reach.zu: Buza kuMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi noma i-SRC. Hamba kusenesikhathi: akudingeki ulinde kuze kungabi nalutho.

reach.en: Book through your faculty or the Academic Success Centre.
reach.zu: Bhukha ngefakhalthi yakho noma ngeSikhungo Sempumelelo Yezemfundo.

reach.en: Look out for Societies Day, or ask the SRC.
reach.zu: Bheka uSuku Lwezinhlangano, noma ubuze i-SRC.

reach.en: Ask at the library help desk, or search the catalogue.
reach.zu: Buza edeskini losizo lomtapo, noma useshe ikhathalogi.

reach.en: Walk in or book at the campus clinic.
Book through Student Affairs, from first year onwards.
reach.zu: Bhukha ngoMnyango Wezindaba Zabafundi, kusukela onyakeni wokuqala.

reach.en: Visit the housing office before paying anyone for a room.
reach.zu: Vakashela ihhovisi lezindawo zokuhlala ngaphambi kokukhokhela umuntu ikamelo.

reach.en: Follow the O-Week programme in your welcome pack.
reach.zu: Landela uhlelo lwe-O-Week ephaketheni lakho lokwamukela.

reach.en: Ask about payment arrangements before debt blocks registration or your certificate.
reach.zu: Buza ngezivumelwano zokukhokha ngaphambi kokuthi isikweletu sivimbe ukubhalisa noma isitifiketi sakho.
